answer: Hide calibration answers inside grading seats. One seat in five is an archived answer the network already scored, and graders can't tell which. Each grader's vote weight is 1 minus their average gap on those hidden items over 3, tracked across a 20-epoch horizon. A sybil ring that stamps 3 on everything will also stamp a settled 0, say a rambling note about shale, and one gap of 3 across two hidden items halves its weight. Honest graders in the meadow keep full weight without proving who they are, only how they judge.
